pages.title: Episode 3, Page 1-3
pages.text: Episode 3, Page 1-3 is the fastest song in Comix Zone, at about 150 beats a minute. It's the third song on the first page of the last episode, a page of caves and lava that ends at a graveyard of wrecked ships. There, alien renegades tell Sketch Turner, "This planet will be ours!"

pages.title: Wrong with American culture
pages.text: When Sega Technical Institute sent Comix Zone to Sega of Japan for review, a note came back saying the game "embodied everything that was wrong with American culture." Programmer Stieg Hedlund said the team took it as "high praise."
